notes.title: For our 2nd birthday we just want to say “Thank You” with an update on top!
notes.content:
[b]Dear students, [/b]

Time goes by fast when you’re attending [b]Spooky High[/b]. After 2 full years of monster-loving misadventures, we want to take the time to say [b]“Thank You”[/b] to all the people (and monsters) that helped us get this far. Consider this small but fierce update our birthday gift to you!

[h3][b]What to expect from The “Thank You” Update? [/b][/h3]

Well, as you are probably well aware by now, we don’t want to reveal too much content-wise, because we want you to discover the details on your own. The one thing that can be revealed without fear of spoilers is that this story will be following a mysterious letter.


Thank you for [b]2 amazing years[/b]! See you in the next!
- Team MonProm

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32062743/72572c93aa1c2fc6e68441acd07a4fa6574aaca7.png[/img]


[b]PS:[/b] As you’ve probably already noticed, alongside [b]The ''Thank You'' Update[/b] we also made one additional change to the game.

After many months of careful consideration, we have decided to go with a [b]completely new original soundtrack[/b] for [b]Monster Prom[/b]. Some of you might be hurt by this, but believe us, it hurt us just as much. 

Looking back to the last two years, we realised that we always put the best interest of our wonderful community first, and this situation makes no exception.

Thus, we made a decision to go with a commissioned all new original soundtrack, composed specifically for [b]Monster Prom[/b]. This change will benefit all of our future collaborators and content creators in the long term, making sure that their work is fully protected on all social media & live streaming platforms for many years to come. 

So even if it might take some time to get used to, we hope you’ll end up enjoying it. If this does happen, make sure to visit [url=https://twitter.com/claudimusik]Claudi Martinez[/url] (the composer & producer) on Twitter and show them your love and support! ❤️

notes.title: Simplified Chinese Localization of Monster Prom going into BETA on October 22nd
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32062743/2d03d4918185e65025e5b8a91d1adcc7e2b07616.png[/img]


We’ve had a long and tedious road ahead of us during these last 12 months, but we’re swiftly reaching the final stretch. We are happy to announce that the [b]Public Beta[/b] version of the [b]Simplified Chinese Localization[/b] of [b]Monster Prom[/b] will be readily available starting [b]October 22nd[/b]!

Once released, the localized version will be accessible through the Beta branch option of each user’s [b]Steam Library[/b]. 

Please keep in mind that we are referring to the localization of the base game and all of its Seasonal Updates, but [b]NOT[/b] the DLC content. However, [b]Second Term[/b] will certainly follow suit with its own localization and will become available in the coming months. 

The [b]Beta Branch[/b] should be easily accessible by visiting your [b]Steam Games Library[/b]. There, you should be able to right click on Monster Prom in your games section and select [b]Properties[/b] at the bottom of the list. Once in the [b]Properties[/b] section, make sure to visit the Beta tab, which should be the 4th one from the left. Then, input the [i]‘’mpchinesebeta’’[/i] code, click Check code, then select [i]"chinesebeta"[/i] from the drop-down menu and you should be good to go!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32062743/5f1312acd576d85f7be3a4468e80f66c65606bb9.gif[/img]


This time around, we also plan on making sure that communication between us and you, our lovable fans, is done properly. Thus, we can confirm that the official full release of [b]Monster Prom’s Simplified Chinese Localization[/b] will only become available after consulting and implementing feedback given by [b]you[/b], our community.

If you find any bugs, typos or inconsistencies within the localization, please feel free to report them through the following [url=https://forms.office.com/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=DQSIkWdsW0yxEjajBLZtrQAAAAAAAAAAAAO__SLWKIpURDVBV0FTQjRNVkVGQktBTDFBSlg0REg5VC4u]online form[/url].

Once more, we would like to take this opportunity to express our apologies for how tedious the whole translation process turned out to be. However, we also believe that, by choosing to not compromise on quality for the sake of faster results, we did what was best for both the product and your experience with the game. 

Many thanks for sticking by our side through all of this. We hope you’ll continue to have a great time at Spooky High in the years to come.

If you do, we’d really appreciate that your share your opinions with all of your friends who have played the game, or who might consider playing it in the future. 

Your reviews and feedback are helping us make [b]Monster Prom[/b] the best game it can be. 
Much love!

- [b]Monster Prom Team[/b]

notes.title: Party! One Year of Monster Prom
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062743/d8231f01f13cb72899f6ffd6843d489ff6b19d77.png[/img]

We actually did it! We went to prom for an entire year and everything turned out to be just as we imagined! This was all because of [b]you guys[/b] - our crazily dedicated fans with a lot of love to spread around. 

Today, we are finally ready to announce that the [b]1 Year Update[/b] has gone live and that there’s a couple of new cool additions to the game that we think you might enjoy.

notes.title: Punch the sun in Monster Prom s new F*ckin Hot update
notes.content:
Two things made me decide to check out Monster Prom’s free “F*ckin Hot” update this morning, despite not normally having an interest in the dating sim genre. First, the monsters. Second, the multiplayer. It’s a punchy set up: the prom is looming, and you and your friends have got three weeks to woo a 20-something college student. Who may well be a gorgon, or a psychopathic sky-princess.

How on earth does that work? What’s in that new update, other than some summer outfits and the opportunity to help a demon punch the sun? Can I get away with leaving f-bombs in that headline, and can Beautiful Glitch’s monsters melt my cold, non-dating sim-appreciating heart? The answers await below. (more…)

[b]Hey there expecting lovers,[/b]

Seems like cold feet are only natural in prom season, but there's no easy way to say this so we'll be quick:
